https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/data-warehouse/tutorial-setup-dbt

(.venv) PS C:\Users\trp\Workspace\Documents\Docs\Work\poc\apps-fabric-dbt\jaffle_shop> dbt debug

Runtime Error

  Profile jaffle_shop in profiles.yml is empty

My profiles.yml file looks like below:-

config:
  partial_parse: true
jaffle_shop:
  target: fabric-dev
  outputs:    
    fabric-dev:
      authentication: CLI
      database: db_trp

Can you please help me here? Thank You
title: dbt debug on Microsoft fabric
answer:
dbt encountered an error while trying to read your profiles.yml file:

I have also received the same error when I tried previously in my environment. After exploring on it, I found the issue is with the path of the profiles.yml file being created.

According to the dbt connection profiles document,

dbt checks your profiles.yml file for a profile with the same name. Then dbt will search the current working directory for the profiles.yml file and will default to the ~/.dbt/ directory if not found.

So, make sure that you have created profiles.yml file in the folder where dbt_project.yml is present and passing the profile name correctly.

I have created it in the same folder with below format and was able to pass all the check connections.

profiles.yml:

jaffle_shop:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
     fabric-dev:
     authentication: CLI
     database: newwarehouseja
     driver: ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server
     host: x6eps4xrq2xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxu.msit-datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com
     schema: dbo
     threads: 4
     type: fabric

Note: Replace host, database names with your actual values correctly and also run az login before debugging the dbt.

Output:

dbt debug

dbt seed

dbt run

Refer MSDoc for setting up the dbt fabric.
